title: select_untagged_data always emits RECENT even when IMAP4rev2 is enabled
description: RFC 9051 (IMAP4rev2) §7.3.2 removes the RECENT response code and the \Recent flag. When a client sends ENABLE IMAP4rev2, the server must not send * RECENT responses. mailbox.rs::select_untagged_data() is a pure function with no parameters and always includes Data::Recent(0) in its output (line 78). The callers in mod.rs (lines 237 and 270, SELECT and EXAMINE handlers) call select_untagged_data() without passing imap4rev2_enabled, so * RECENT 0 is always sent even after the client has ENABLEd IMAP4rev2 semantics. This is a protocol conformance bug and a maintainer trap: imap4rev2_enabled exists on SessionContext but is not threaded through to the function that needs it. Future maintainers adding real message counts will need to fix this anyway; a note now prevents them from unknowingly extending the non-conformant path. Fix: add imap4rev2_enabled: bool parameter to select_untagged_data() and omit Data::Recent from the result when true. Update both callers in mod.rs to pass ctx.imap4rev2_enabled.
